newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Safeway.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Safeway.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Meredith Adler said she initiated coverage of Safeway Inc with a buy rating.
-- The brokerage added the supermarket chain to its U.S. recommended list and set a target price of $58, said Jeffrey Applegate, Lehman's U.S. equities strategist.

-- In published comments, Applegate said Safeway's formula of successful cost-cutting, lower prices and improved service is likely to continue to produce strong earnings growth for at least the next two years and outperform the market as a result.
